title: Unit Event — Find A Way Out — Episode7 Eyes Like Them

meta.Event Outline: Tis the season to be jolly and Vivid BAD SQUAD is all gathered at Weekend Garage. They discuss performing at the live house where RADder debuted, but Akito seems to have some history with said venue...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm panting more, and my legs are starting to feel heavy...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But I can't stop...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...
Hey, kid.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? T-Taiga...?! What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Well, this place is sort of like my backyard. It's only natural for me to want to check up on it.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: More importantly, why do you look so flustered? I thought you won that battle just now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Won that battle...? Wait, were you watching?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah. I was out for a stroll and saw you guys singing. So, I decided to stop and watch.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: They weren't bad, but couldn't quite run away with it. You got them good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I did...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Here, drink this.
You'll start feeling sick if you don't stay hydrated.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, thank you. I appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's like he's staring right into me... I can't hide anything from him.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, a long time ago, I lost to them pretty badly. But I managed to beat them today...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, that must've felt pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, it did... But...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't like how this brief sense of relief came over me. I can't forgive myself for letting that happen...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Why's that...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Most would probably say that I was able to win today because of how much work I've been putting in until now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: However, I won't be able to move forward if I let myself feel satisfied over something like this...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Move forward, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, because I can still remember the way you guys sang during RAD WEEKEND. I still can't believe what happened that night...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I need to learn how to do that.
So, I can't hesitate or let myself feel satisfied for even a second.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: My dream... Our dream... It requires us to aim as high as we can. Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You're starting to sound like Ken.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: He also worked as hard as he absolutely could.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: To catch up to me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ken had to work that hard...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, he always has that cool look on his face, but I don't know anyone who loves music more than him.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But things were different in the beginning. He was the opposite when I met him for the first time in junior high. I mean, he was so boring back then.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: He overcame every obstacle that was thrown at him, but it was like he didn't care. He acted like he was so mature and hardly ever paid attention to anyone else.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I didn't know how to deal with that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I heard rumors that Ken and Taiga didn't get along, but I guess they were at least partially true.)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But it wasn't just that...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I can tell you this because enough time's passed. I actually kept a close eye on him whenever I was in town.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: We both grew up around here, so we saw each other constantly. Be it school, sports or whatever, he always managed to come out on top.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Singing was the only thing I was better at than him. However, a part of me always worried about what would happen if he also started taking that seriously...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I'd been singing here since I was little, and I believed I was gonna become world famous.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: One day, Ken walked by while I was doing a street performance... He gave me this look of boredom which really bothered me.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I thought, “Hey, don't ignore me! You know I'm here! Isn't there anything you feel passionate about?!”

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, I began singing like there was no tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Not even Tono could stand up to Taiga... I can't imagine what he's like when he fully unleashes...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, what did Ken do after that?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Oh, my performance definitely sparked something inside him. It was pretty obvious.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: His eyes began to visibly fill with light.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I guess it goes to show that you gotta take something seriously if you want others to notice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Take something seriously...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah. And so, he decided to start singing in this town.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I couldn't believe it when I saw Ken practicing for the first time. It was like I'd stepped on a sleeping tiger's tail...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: He practiced from sunup to sundown while always keeping a bigger goal in mind.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: He'd sing for so long that he'd lose his voice and get this dejected look on his face. Despite that, he kept going. It didn't matter if he could hardly make a sound.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ken practiced like that...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Weird, right? Again, I couldn't believe it.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: He probably didn't know what to do with all that newfound energy. I have a feeling that he was so excited that he had no other choice but to act.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: He sang and sang and defeated everyone in his path, but he never felt satisfied. He just kept going.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: From my perspective, it's always nice to get a win.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: At the same time, seeing him get all serious became good motivation for me.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Honestly, it was sort of nice to see him break a sweat for a change...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And before I knew it, we were teammates.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Come to think of it, your eyes... Ken always had that same look. Actually, you really reminded me of him during your show today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Me...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, it's like you're only looking towards the top, and you're mindlessly doing everything you can to reach it.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You might actually have what it takes to become just like him. But it's gonna be tough... Really tough.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Anyway, I think this old man's wasted enough of your time. I didn't mean to tell you such a long story.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, it's rare for anyone to hear about you guys' history. So, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: No problem.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Oh, while we're on the subject...
I heard that you guys want to do an event at Crawl Green.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? We do, but we haven't received permission yet.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, don't give me that. Ken and I probably would've jammed our feet in the door and squeezed our way through.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, I really don't think we should go that far. I mean, this event means a lot to us, so we're trying to go about this carefully...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, Taiga, why do you know about it...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The owner told me. Arata's been talking to him, right?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: He even said how everyone's been talking about the events you guys have been putting on recently.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, well... We're doing what we can to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's our main goal.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Right...
I'm curious to see just how strong your resolve is when it comes to that.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Alright, I'll go see your next show.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What...?
You will...?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Sure. That is, if you manage to book Crawl Green. When you guys do, save a ticket for me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Of course! Um...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We promise to make it an incredible event. So, we'll be waiting for you...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: He practiced from sunup to sundown while always keeping a bigger goal in mind.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: He'd sing for so long that he'd lose his voice and get this dejected look on his face. Despite that, he kept going. It didn't matter if he could hardly make a sound.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I had no idea that Ken went through the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He did absolutely everything in his power to get where he wanted...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And I've been doing what I can until now after choosing to go down this path. Still...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Come to think of it, your eyes... Ken always had that same look. Actually, you really reminded me of him during your show today.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You might actually have what it takes to become just like him. But it's gonna be tough... Really tough.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: It's easy for your mind to fall into the trap of believing there's no more use in trying. That there's no light at the end of the tunnel.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, whenever you feel that way, don't listen to your mind. Listen to your heart. Follow it. Go after what gets your blood pumping.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: That's right. If you feel down and like everything's falling apart, but your body still wants to sing...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: That means you shouldn't quit and singing is the only way you'll break through your ceiling.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Now I see...
That's why Ken said what he did.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He felt that same anguish as he continued to sing...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He wasn't an incredible singer from the start... He had to work for it.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Like me...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. Finally...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I can have confidence in the decisions I've made. I can move forward.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: At long last...
